posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: No major new release this week — Katrina remains in mom mode, her most recent notable activity a heartwarming 'May dump' Instagram carousel featuring husband Vicky Kaushal and their baby son Vihaan.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Imtiaz Ali film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' is showing surprising legs in theatres, while he builds buzz for his horror-comedy 'Sardaar Ji 3,' whose teaser is out ahead of a June 27 release.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: The trailer for Alia's YRF spy-universe action thriller 'Alpha' (with Sharvari and a Hrithik Roshan cameo) just dropped, drawing 'blockbuster' praise from Karan Johar and Sonam Kapoor.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is deep into SS Rajamouli's mega-budget 'Varanasi' opposite Mahesh Babu alongside her Hollywood thriller 'The Bluff,' and shared a sweet Father's Day post for husband Nick Jonas and daughter Malti.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK is gearing up for his action film 'King,' co-starring daughter Suhana Khan and Deepika Padukone, with leaked behind-the-scenes clips sparking fan excitement.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena has been cheering on sister Karisma Kapoor — calling her 'the absolute '90s Queen' — as Karisma's series 'Brown' began streaming alongside husband Saif Ali Khan.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor's upcoming film Eetha (with Randeep Hooda) has locked an August 28, 2026 release, with its teaser reportedly set to be attached with Cocktail 2 in theatres.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh, Deepika is reportedly using a body double for action sequences in Allu Arjun's Raaka while wrapping her portions for Shah Rukh Khan's King.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh's blockbuster Dhurandhar is set to release in Japan on July 10, 2026, as the franchise climbs the all-time global box office charts.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan continues to make headlines for her show-stopping Cannes 2026 red-carpet appearances for L'Oréal, including a dreamy blush-pink couture gown, with daughter Aaradhya joining her.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna's Cocktail 2 (with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon) is drawing strong advance bookings after earning an 'A' certificate, while her period drama Ranabaali adds Hollywood actor Arnold Vosloo.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu is promoting her upcoming Telugu film Maa Inti Bangaaram alongside husband and producer Raj Nidimoru, whose playful 'nothing new' response at the pre-release event went viral.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is deep into shooting Atlee's big-budget pan-India action spectacle 'Raaka' (AA22xA6) opposite Deepika Padukone, while his next with Lokesh Kanagaraj is also in the works.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama 'Peddi' has crossed Rs 200+ crore in India, with makers adding new footage; he and wife Upasana also just shared the first pictures of their twins Shivram and Anveera.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR is shooting Prashanth Neel's two-part action epic 'Dragon' simultaneously, reportedly losing around 15 kg for his intense anti-hero transformation, with Part 1 slated for June 2027.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor remains at the center of the 'Peddi' controversy as makers re-edit the film, even as she rides the acclaim of her Cannes debut 'Homebound' and lines up 'Lag Ja Gale'.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday is fresh off her romantic drama 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya and has been sharing vacation snaps, while drawing support from her teachers after online trolling.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani made a glamorous post-motherhood runway comeback as showstopper for designer Rahul Mishra alongside Karan Johar, and is gearing up for her next film 'Toxic' with Yash.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: The newly released Alpha trailer confirmed Hrithik Roshan's surprise cameo as Kabir, tying the Alia Bhatt-Sharvari led YRF spy film into the Spyverse franchise.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's reunion with father David Dhawan, the rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' co-starring Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde, hit theatres and opened to a steady run.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal's new release 'Nabz Nabz (Female Version)' is out, and she made a buzzy appearance at the 'Pritam And Pedro' trailer launch as she rides the success of her global All Hearts Tour.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman is in the spotlight for composing the music of Imtiaz Ali's 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' (starring Diljit Dosanjh), and publicly responded after a satirical post labeled the partition-era love story 'anti-national.'

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Now serving as Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister after his party TVK's historic 2026 election win, Thalapathy Vijay is seeing massive buzz build for his final film 'Jana Nayagan,' slated to release later this month.
